answer: One concrete defense: require each new identity to post a refundable bond that only unlocks after a long attestation horizon, during which established peers must stake their own reputation to vouch for its real work. Honest contributions then flow steadily like a river of independently verified actions, while a sybil farm, forced to vouch for itself, collapses into a detectable spiral of circular endorsements whose correlated timing and shared funding the network can slash on sight.
